---
title: "Sampling Points"
---

Each bubble marks a field station where trees were measured. Bubble size scales with the total biomass measured at that station; color matches the station's lagoon sector (see the [Sector Explorer](explorer.qmd) for sector-level detail). Click a bubble for its species composition and the individual trees sampled there.

## Sampling points

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
biomassPoints = FileAttachment("data/biomass-points.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
trees = FileAttachment("data/dataset.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sectorLabels = ({upper: "Upper", lower: "Lower", "main creek": "Main Creek"})
sectorColors = ({upper: "#2c7bb6", lower: "#d7191c", "main creek": "#1a9641"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Defined (and displayed, as the live map container) in this same cell:
// a separate cell that only *references* mapDiv would show a generic
// object inspector instead of embedding the live DOM node.
mapDiv = html`<div id="sector-map"></div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
map = {
  const m = L.map(mapDiv, { scrollWheelZoom: false }).setView([16.62, -88.34], 12);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>',
    maxZoom: 19,
  }).addTo(m);
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Manual sqrt scale (avoids a bare `d3` reference, which Quarto's OJS
// runtime does not provide as an ambient global the way Observable
// notebooks do — referencing it directly stalls the cell forever).
maxBiomassPerPoint = Math.max(...biomassPoints.map((d) => d.total_biomass_kg))
biomassRadius = (v) => 4 + 14 * Math.sqrt(v / maxBiomassPerPoint)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
stationPopup = (d) => {
  const stationTrees = trees.filter((t) => t.station_id === d.station_id);
  const fmt = (v, digits = 1) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(digits) : "—");

  const counts = {};
  for (const t of stationTrees) {
    counts[t.species] = (counts[t.species] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  let speciesRows = Object.entries(counts)
    .map(([species, n]) => ({ species, n, pct: (100 * n) / stationTrees.length }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n || a.species.localeCompare(b.species));

  // Group single-tree species as "Other" so the dominant species stay readable.
  // If every species is a singleton, list them individually instead of showing
  // a single 100% "Other" row.
  const majors = speciesRows.filter((r) => r.n > 1);
  const minors = speciesRows.filter((r) => r.n === 1);
  if (majors.length > 0 && minors.length > 0) {
    const nMinor = minors.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.n, 0);
    speciesRows = [
      ...majors,
      {
        species: "Other (minor species)",
        note: minors.map((r) => r.species).join(", "),
        n: nMinor,
        pct: (100 * nMinor) / stationTrees.length,
        minor: true,
      },
    ];
  }

  const speciesTable = speciesRows
    .map(
      (r) => `
        <tr${r.minor ? ' class="minor"' : ""}>
          <td>${r.species}${r.note ? `<div class="minor-note">${r.note}</div>` : ""}</td>
          <td class="num">${r.pct.toFixed(0)}%</td>
          <td class="num">${r.n}</td>
        </tr>`
    )
    .join("");

  const treeList = stationTrees
    .map(
      (t) => `
        <li>
          <span class="tree-species">${t.species}</span>
          <span class="tree-meta">${t.morphotype} &middot; ${fmt(t.dbh_cm)} cm DBH &middot; ${fmt(t.height_m)} m tall &middot; ${fmt(t.total_biomass_kg)} kg biomass</span>
        </li>`
    )
    .join("");

  return `
    <div class="station-popup">
      <h4>${sectorLabels[d.sector] ?? d.sector} &middot; Station ${d.station_id}</h4>
      <div class="station-popup-meta">${stationTrees.length} trees sampled &middot; ${fmt(d.total_biomass_kg)} kg total biomass</div>
      <h5>Relative frequency by species</h5>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Species</th><th class="num">Frequency</th><th class="num">Trees</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${speciesTable}</tbody>
      </table>
      <h5>Trees sampled</h5>
      <ol class="station-popup-trees">${treeList}</ol>
    </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
pointsLayer = {
  const layer = L.layerGroup(
    biomassPoints.map((d) =>
      L.circleMarker([d.lat, d.long], {
        radius: biomassRadius(d.total_biomass_kg),
        color: "#333",
        weight: 1,
        fillColor: sectorColors[d.sector] ?? "#888",
        fillOpacity: 0.7,
      })
        .bindTooltip(
          `${sectorLabels[d.sector] ?? d.sector} station ${d.station_id}<br>
           ${d.n_trees} trees sampled &middot; ${d.total_biomass_kg.toFixed(1)} kg total biomass`
        )
        .bindPopup(stationPopup(d), { maxWidth: 520, className: "station-popup-leaflet" })
    )
  );
  layer.addTo(map);
  return layer;
}
```

:::{#sector-map-legend}
Bubble size scales with total measured biomass at that station.
:::
